title: Worst App Ever
body: I was hopeful for this but every single “farm” or store I clicked on was either closed, flat out non existent, or did not sell what the app claimed they sold. There was a store that literally NEVER existed ever and the address listed was some random persons house in a gated community. I’m so disappointed in this app I wish I could give 0 stars.

title: Save your money
body: If you’re going to charge people money for this app, you have to be better than google search near me … not worse. Museums listed. Incomplete and incorrect listings. Nice try though.

title: Disappointed
body: Very disappointed. After I signed up it only showed one farm in all of Marin County. How can I use this? Going to fresh farm and see what I can find there.
